note: JBIGDecode(TIFF* tif, uint8* buffer, tmsize_t size, uint16 s) (libtiff/tif_jbig.c) explicitly discards its own `size` parameter -- the caller-supplied capacity of `buffer` -- via `(void) size, (void) s;` at function entry (line 54) and never reads it again. `_TIFFmemcpy(buffer, pImage, jbg_dec_getsize(&decoder))` (line 100) then copies however many bytes the JBIG codestream decoded to into `buffer`, with no comparison anywhere in the function against `size`. Since the decoded size is derived entirely from the attacker-supplied JBIG codestream inside the input TIFF, a codestream that decodes larger than the caller's buffer overflows it.

traces.message: JBIGDecode()'s `size` parameter (the caller-supplied capacity of `buffer`) is explicitly discarded via `(void) size, (void) s;` at function entry and never read again in the function
_TIFFmemcpy(buffer, pImage, jbg_dec_getsize(&decoder)) -- copies the JBIG decoder's own reported output size into `buffer` with no comparison against `size`; CWE-787 out-of-bounds write
